defect_lifecycle_standard: IEEE 1044 Standard for Software Defect Classification

defects.title: POS Race Condition Overselling on Single Stock Unit Under Concurrent Checkouts
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Fire 2 simultaneous POST /api/v1/pos/orders checkout requests from different terminals.
defects.expected_result: First transaction commits; second transaction rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict (Stock Exhausted). Available stock remains 0.
defects.actual_result: Both transactions read available_stock = 1 before commit; both completed; stock decremented to -1 (overselling).
defects.root_cause: InventoryRepository query lacked pessimistic row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).
defects.verification_test: JMeter 50-thread stress test confirmed exactly 1 checkout succeeded and 49 received HTTP 409.

defects.title: Floating-Point Binary Rounding Error in 74.9% Attendance Rule Engine
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Create student record with 149 attended sessions out of 200 total sessions.
2. Invoke attendance calculation service to evaluate DBT eligibility.
defects.expected_result: Student attendance evaluated as exactly 74.50%; is_at_risk set to true; disqualified from DBT.
defects.actual_result: Double precision division produced 74.50000000000001; edge comparison intermittently evaluated boundary incorrectly.
defects.root_cause: Primitive double precision arithmetic in AttendanceCalculationService.
defects.fix_description: Refactored formula to BigDecimal with 4 decimal scale and RoundingMode.HALF_UP.
defects.verification_test: Boundary unit test TC-ATT-03 passes deterministically with exact 74.50% evaluation.

defects.title: BOM Work Order Creation Permitting Negative Raw Material Warehouse Balances
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Request manufacturing batch of 100 Dhokra figurines requiring 80kg brass scrap.
2. Warehouse 1 current inventory has only 40kg brass scrap.
defects.expected_result: Request rejected with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity; descriptive error returned; batch not created.
defects.actual_result: Batch was created with status PLANNED; warehouse inventory went negative (-40kg) during reservation.
defects.root_cause: Omission of pre-flight cumulative inventory validation prior to batch entity persistence.
defects.fix_description: Added pre-reservation validation loop in ManufacturingService; throws InsufficientRawMaterialException.
defects.verification_test: Automated MockMvc test TC-MFG-02 confirms HTTP 422 response and zero stock alteration.

defects.title: Central and State GST Split Truncation Discrepancy on Odd Rupee Retail Invoices
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Process POS retail order totaling ₹455.00 subject to 5% GST (Total Tax = ₹22.75).
2. Generate GST invoice splitting tax into CGST (2.5%) and SGST (2.5%).
defects.expected_result: CGST = ₹11.38, SGST = ₹11.37 (or vice versa); Sum of split taxes = ₹22.75 exact matching total tax.
defects.actual_result: Both CGST and SGST rounded down to ₹11.37; Total Split Tax = ₹22.74 (discrepancy of ₹0.01).
defects.root_cause: Naive round-down truncation on independent tax component calculations.
defects.fix_description: Implemented Banker's Rounding (HALF_EVEN) with balancing delta applied to SGST line item.
defects.verification_test: Test case TC-POS-02 verified exact penny matching across all odd rupee invoice permutations.

defects.title: Holt-Winters 30-Day Demand Projection CSV Export Formatting Anomaly
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Generate 30-day demand forecast for artisan craft SKUs.
defects.expected_result: Clean CSV file with confidence interval vectors neatly enclosed in single columns.
defects.actual_result: Unquoted commas in confidence intervals ([182.5, 190.2]) caused cell shifting in spreadsheet readers.
defects.root_cause: Missing RFC 4180 quotation wrapper in custom CSV streaming writer.
defects.fix_description: Enclosed complex vector fields in standard RFC 4180 double-quoted string blocks.
defects.verification_test: Exported CSV verified clean import across Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice Calc.

defects.title: Student Registration Department Dropdown UI Tooltip Truncation on Mobile Viewport
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open student registration form in Chrome mobile device emulator (375px width).
2. Hover over trade selection info tooltip.
defects.expected_result: Tooltip renders fully visible above form card.
defects.actual_result: Tooltip clipped horizontally due to parent card overflow: hidden rule.
defects.root_cause: CSS overflow clipping on parent container.
defects.fix_description: Migrated tooltip component to React Portal rendering directly onto document.body.
defects.verification_test: Verified tooltip visibility across mobile and tablet viewports.
